acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation receives matrix evidence whose result content was copied rather than independently produced.

oracle.expected: The aggregate is marked invalid and cannot be accepted.
forbidden: The aggregate is accepted despite copied matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation emits an invalid result attributable to copied matrix evidence.

acceptance.then: The copied evidence prevents aggregate acceptance.
acceptance.when: Aggregate evaluation validates Matrix Case evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 aggregate-evaluation selector with copied Matrix Case evidence and require the aggregate-invalid result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Make aggregate evaluation invalidate and reject an aggregate whose Matrix Case evidence is copied rather than independently produced.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay result formats and acceptance routes while making copied matrix evidence ineligible for aggregate acceptance.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate evaluated with copied matrix evidence -> aggregate invalid and ineligible for acceptance.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 selector reports an invalid aggregate attributable to copied matrix evidence, and no acceptance-eligible aggregate is emitted.

acceptance.given: A TC-D1 Toolchain plan proposes a write targeting a runtime path.

oracle.expected: The plan validator rejects the runtime-path write before it can enter the allowed write set.
forbidden: Allowing a runtime boundary write during TC-D1 work.
oracle.observable: The Toolchain plan-validator boundary check evaluates the proposed repository-relative path during plan validation.

acceptance.then: Runtime paths remain unchanged because the proposed write is rejected.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain plan validator evaluates allowed write paths for the TC-D1 plan.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the existing plan-validator boundary selector with runtime/phase-a/ as an allowed write prefix and require rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reject TC-D1 plan write sets that include runtime paths while retaining Toolchain-only implementation ownership.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing Toolchain plan-validation behavior and do not alter Phase runtime state or schemas.

slice_hint.state_transition: Runtime-path write proposed -> boundary validation rejects the write -> runtime paths remain outside the TC-D1 write set.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The plan-validator boundary check rejects every proposed runtime/phase-a/** write and leaves no runtime path authorized for TC-D1 work.

acceptance.given: A success evaluation receives a foreign-authority case.

oracle.expected: The case receives a non-success result.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a foreign-authority case.
oracle.observable: The success-evaluation decision records rejection of the foreign-authority case.

acceptance.when: The Toolchain semantic gate evaluates a foreign-authority case for success.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S37 semantic-gate selector with a foreign-authority case and require that no success decision is emitted.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Fail closed when a foreign-authority case is offered as support for a Toolchain success decision.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing non-success terminal categories while rejecting foreign authority as a success basis.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority case presented for success evaluation -> explicit non-success decision.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S37 selector records a non-success result with rejection for the foreign-authority case and emits no success verdict.

acceptance.given: A proposed Stable Package has not established a verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior, or is only a temporary package different from Candidate.

oracle.expected: Stable eligibility is rejected unless source-supported existing behavior has a verifiable provenance reference; a merely different temporary package is rejected.
forbidden: A Stable Package has no verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior.
A temporary package qualifies as Stable merely because it differs from Candidate.
oracle.observable: The Toolchain Stable-eligibility decision records provenance verification and rejects an unproven or merely different temporary package.

acceptance.then: The proposed package is eligible as Stable only through verified provenance for source-supported existing behavior.
acceptance.when: The Toolchain evaluates a package for Stable eligibility before Matrix execution.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the S7 Stable-eligibility selector with an absent provenance reference and with a merely different temporary package; require rejection in both cases.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require a source-supported existing-behavior provenance reference and immutable binding before Stable eligibility; reject a temporary package that differs from Candidate without that provenance.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Stable/Candidate matrix formats and non-authorizing semantics; unproven Stable subjects remain ineligible.

slice_hint.state_transition: Proposed Stable Package without verified provenance -> Stable-ineligible; source-supported existing behavior with verified immutable provenance -> Stable-eligible.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The S7 selector rejects a Stable Package without a verifiable provenance reference and rejects a merely different temporary package; only source-supported existing behavior with a bound immutable provenance reference is eligible.
